introduction: This spec defines the CLI layer for managing secrets and variables in the `afc` command-line tool, providing `afc secrets` and `afc vars` command groups that parse arguments and flags, call the hub REST API via `apikit.CLIClient`, and print results following the established `afc workspace` patterns.

glossary.07-REQ-16: The requirement in spec `07_secrets_variables` that defines the `GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/vars/resolved` endpoint returning the merged variable set for a workspace.
glossary.BuildRootCommand: The function in `internal/cli/workspace_cmd.go` that assembles the root Cobra command and registers all subcommand groups.
glossary.CLIClient: The `apikit` HTTP client type with a `DoRequest(ctx, method, path, body) (any, error)` method used to call the hub REST API.
glossary.CLIClientFromCmd: The `apikit` function `func CLIClientFromCmd(cmd *cobra.Command) (*CLIClient, error)` that instantiates an authenticated HTTP client from the Cobra command context.
glossary.CLIHandleError: The `apikit` function `func CLIHandleError(cmd *cobra.Command, err error) error` that prints an API error envelope and returns the error.
glossary.CLIPrintResult: The `apikit` function `func CLIPrintResult(cmd *cobra.Command, v any) error` that serializes and prints the full API response as JSON to stdout.
glossary.DoRequest: The method `func (c *CLIClient) DoRequest(ctx context.Context, method, path string, body any) (any, error)` on `CLIClient` that executes an HTTP request and returns the parsed response body or nil for 204 responses.
glossary.NewCLIError: The `apikit` function `func NewCLIError(code int, message string) *CLIError` that constructs a CLI error with a specific exit code.
glossary.PAT: Personal Access Token — an authentication credential used to identify the caller when making API requests.
glossary.SecretsCmd: The Cobra command group constructor function returning the `afc secrets` parent command, implemented in `internal/cli/secrets_cmd.go`.
glossary.VarsCmd: The Cobra command group constructor function returning the `afc vars` parent command, implemented in `internal/cli/vars_cmd.go`.
glossary.afc: The primary command-line interface for the agent-fox platform.
glossary.hadError: A boolean tracking variable in multi-scope create commands that is set to `true` if any per-scope API call fails, used to determine the final exit code.
glossary.org scope: The ownership scope targeting an organization identified by slug, using API path prefix `orgs/<slug>/secrets` or `orgs/<slug>/vars`.
glossary.ownership selector: A CLI flag (`--user`, `--org`, or `--workspace`) that determines which API path segment is used when calling the hub REST API.
glossary.resolved variable set: The merged, precedence-ordered set of variables for a workspace returned by `GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/vars/resolved`, where each entry includes an `origin` field indicating which tier (`user`, `org`, or `workspace`) the value came from.
glossary.secrets_cmd.go: The new file `internal/cli/secrets_cmd.go` that implements `SecretsCmd()` and all `afc secrets` subcommands.
glossary.user scope: The ownership scope targeting the authenticated user, using API path prefix `user/secrets` or `user/vars`.
glossary.vars_cmd.go: The new file `internal/cli/vars_cmd.go` that implements `VarsCmd()` and all `afc vars` subcommands.
glossary.workspace scope: The ownership scope targeting a workspace identified by slug, using API path prefix `workspaces/<slug>/secrets` or `workspaces/<slug>/vars`.
glossary.workspace_cmd.go: The existing file `internal/cli/workspace_cmd.go` that contains `BuildRootCommand` and serves as the canonical implementation reference for CLI command patterns.

requirements.title: Register SecretsCmd and VarsCmd in BuildRootCommand

user_story.goal: have `afc secrets` and `afc vars` available as top-level command groups
user_story.benefit: users can manage secrets and variables from the CLI without additional setup

acceptance_criteria.action: call `SecretsCmd()` and `VarsCmd()` and register both returned commands via `root.AddCommand` in `workspace_cmd.go`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the root Cobra command includes `secrets` and `vars` as subcommands accessible via `afc secrets` and `afc vars`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: BuildRootCommand is called

edge_cases.action: panic at startup with a clear message indicating which constructor returned nil
edge_cases.return_contract: process terminates with a non-zero exit code and a descriptive panic message before any user interaction
edge_cases.error_condition: `SecretsCmd()` or `VarsCmd()` returns a nil command due to a programming error

requirements.title: afc secrets create — single and multi-scope secret creation

user_story.goal: create one or more secrets at one or more ownership scopes with a single command
user_story.benefit: I can populate secrets across user, org, and workspace scopes without running multiple commands

acceptance_criteria.action: parse the `key=value` argument, default to `user scope`, call `DoRequest` with POST to `/api/v1/user/secrets` with body `{"entries":[{"key":"KEY","value":"val"}]}`, then call `CLIPrintResult` with the full response
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exits 0; stdout contains the JSON response `{"entries":[{"key":"...","created_at":"...","updated_at":"..."}]}`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user runs `afc secrets create KEY=val` with no ownership flags

acceptance_criteria.action: parse the argument, call `DoRequest` with POST to `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets` with the entries body, then call `CLIPrintResult` with the full response
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exits 0; stdout contains the JSON response for the org scope
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user runs `afc secrets create KEY=val --org myorg`

acceptance_criteria.action: parse the argument, call `DoRequest` with POST to `/api/v1/workspaces/myws/secrets` with the entries body, then call `CLIPrintResult` with the full response
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exits 0; stdout contains the JSON response for the workspace scope
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user runs `afc secrets create KEY=val --workspace myws`

acceptance_criteria.action: make three sequential `DoRequest` POST calls in fixed order: first to `/api/v1/user/secrets`, then `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets`, then `/api/v1/workspaces/myws/secrets`; call `CLIPrintResult` after each successful call
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exits 0 if all three calls succeed; stdout contains three JSON response objects in order
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user runs `afc secrets create KEY=val --user --org myorg --workspace myws`

acceptance_criteria.action: split the argument on commas, parse each `key=value` pair, and include all entries in a single `DoRequest` POST call body as `{"entries":[{"key":"KEY1","value":"val1"},{"key":"KEY2","value":"val2"}]}`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exits 0; stdout contains the JSON response with all created entries
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a user runs `afc secrets create KEY1=val1,KEY2=val2`

edge_cases.action: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` without calling `DoRequest`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits 2; stderr contains a descriptive parse error message; no API call is made
edge_cases.error_condition: the argument string contains no `=` character (e.g. `afc secrets create BADKEY`)

edge_cases.action: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` with a message such as "empty key in argument at position N" without calling `DoRequest`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits 2; stderr contains the positional parse error message; no API call is made
edge_cases.error_condition: comma-splitting produces an empty or whitespace-only key at position N (e.g. `KEY=val,,KEY2=val2`)

edge_cases.action: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` indicating a required argument is missing
edge_cases.return_contract: exits 2; stderr contains a usage error message; no API call is made
edge_cases.error_condition: no positional argument is provided

edge_cases.action: call `CLIHandleError` immediately for the failing scope, set `hadError` to `true`, continue executing remaining scopes in user → org → workspace order, and after all scopes complete return `NewCLIError(1, "")` because `hadError` is `true`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits 1; stderr contains the API error envelope for the failed scope; successful scopes still produce stdout output
edge_cases.error_condition: one scope's `DoRequest` call fails during a multi-scope create (e.g. `--user --org myorg`)

edge_cases.action: call `CLIHandleError` with the error and return the resulting error from `RunE`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits non-zero; stderr contains the JSON API error envelope
edge_cases.error_condition: `DoRequest` returns an API error for a single-scope create

edge_cases.action: return the error from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits non-zero; stderr contains the client initialization error
edge_cases.error_condition: `CLIClientFromCmd` returns an error (e.g. missing API key configuration)

edge_cases.error_condition: the API returns an empty array (no secrets exist at the scope)

requirements.title: key=value argument parsing — split on first = and validate

user_story.goal: have a consistent, correct parser for key=value arguments used across all create and update subcommands
user_story.benefit: users get clear error messages for malformed arguments before any API call is made

acceptance_criteria.action: split the input string on the first `=` character; the key is everything before the first `=` and the value is everything after it (the value may contain additional `=` characters)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (key string, value string) where value may contain `=` characters

acceptance_criteria.action: split on commas first to obtain individual `key=value` tokens, then parse each token by splitting on the first `=`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a slice of (key, value) pairs; shell-level quoting is required for values containing commas
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the input string for a create command is comma-separated (e.g. `KEY1=val1,KEY2=val2`)

edge_cases.action: return an error without contacting the API
edge_cases.return_contract: returns an error; the calling command returns `NewCLIError(2, message)` and exits 2
edge_cases.error_condition: the input token contains no `=` character

edge_cases.action: return an error with a message identifying the zero-based position of the empty entry
edge_cases.return_contract: returns an error such as "empty key in argument at position N"; the calling command returns `NewCLIError(2, message)` and exits 2
edge_cases.error_condition: after comma-splitting, a token produces an empty or whitespace-only key (e.g. from `KEY=val,,KEY2=val2`)

edge_cases.action: pass the key through to the API as-is without any additional validation beyond the empty/whitespace guard; all other key validation is performed server-side
edge_cases.return_contract: the key string is forwarded unchanged in the API request body

requirements.title: Ownership selector resolution — default to user scope when no flags provided

user_story.goal: have commands default to my user scope when I omit ownership flags
user_story.benefit: I can manage my own secrets and variables without typing `--user` every time

acceptance_criteria.action: treat the command as targeting `user scope` and use the `user/secrets` or `user/vars` API path prefix
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the API call is made to `/api/v1/user/secrets` or `/api/v1/user/vars` as appropriate
acceptance_criteria.state: all three ownership flag variables (`--user` bool, `--org` string, `--workspace` string) remain at their zero values after flag parsing

acceptance_criteria.action: define `--user` as a `BoolVar` with default `false`; detect the no-flags-provided case at runtime by checking whether all three flag variables are at zero values, rather than setting the `--user` default to `true`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the `--user` flag is a true opt-in boolean; the implicit default is handled by runtime logic, not flag defaults

edge_cases.action: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` before calling `DoRequest`
edge_cases.return_contract: exits 2; stderr contains an error message stating that only one scope selector is allowed for this command
edge_cases.error_condition: for list, update, or delete commands: two or more of `--user`, `--org`, and `--workspace` are provided simultaneously

edge_cases.action: execute three API calls in fixed order: user scope first, then org scope, then workspace scope; each call uses the appropriate API path prefix
edge_cases.return_contract: all three scopes are targeted; API calls are made in deterministic user → org → workspace order
edge_cases.trigger: for create commands: `--user`, `--org`, and `--workspace` are all provided

correctness_properties.title: Multi-scope create API call ordering is always user → org → workspace
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `afc secrets create` or `afc vars create` with any combination of `--user`, `--org`, and `--workspace` flags
correctness_properties.invariant: API calls to `DoRequest` are always made in the fixed order: `user scope` first (if `--user` is set or no flags are provided), then `org scope` (if `--org` is set), then `workspace scope` (if `--workspace` is set); this order is never permuted regardless of the order flags appear on the command line

correctness_properties.title: Partial multi-scope failure always yields exit code 1
correctness_properties.for_any: multi-scope create invocation where at least one scope's `DoRequest` call fails and at least one succeeds
correctness_properties.invariant: `hadError` is set to `true` on the first failure; all remaining scopes are still attempted in order; the command returns `NewCLIError(1, "")` after all scopes complete, yielding exit code 1 regardless of which scope failed

correctness_properties.title: DELETE commands never call CLIPrintResult
correctness_properties.for_any: any invocation of `afc secrets delete` or `afc vars delete` that receives a 204 No Content response (nil body from `DoRequest`)
correctness_properties.invariant: `CLIPrintResult` is never called; stdout remains empty; the confirmation message is written only to stderr via `fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), ...)`

correctness_properties.title: No API call is made when argument parsing fails
correctness_properties.for_any: any command invocation where the positional argument fails parsing (missing `=`, empty key, wrong argument count)
correctness_properties.invariant: `CLIClientFromCmd` and `DoRequest` are never called; the command returns `NewCLIError(2, message)` immediately after detecting the parse error

correctness_properties.title: Single-scope commands reject multiple ownership selectors
correctness_properties.for_any: any invocation of `afc secrets list`, `afc secrets update`, `afc secrets delete`, `afc vars list`, `afc vars update`, or `afc vars delete` with two or more of `--user`, `--org`, `--workspace` set
correctness_properties.invariant: the command returns `NewCLIError(2, message)` and exits 2 without calling `DoRequest`

correctness_properties.title: No-flags default always resolves to user scope
correctness_properties.for_any: any command invocation where none of `--user`, `--org`, or `--workspace` flags are provided
correctness_properties.invariant: the command targets `user scope` and calls `DoRequest` with a path beginning with `/api/v1/user/`; this is detected by runtime zero-value checking, not by a `--user` BoolVar default of `true`

correctness_properties.title: CLIPrintResult receives the full DoRequest response without reshaping
correctness_properties.for_any: any non-DELETE command that receives a successful API response
correctness_properties.invariant: `CLIPrintResult` is called with the exact value returned by `DoRequest` — the CLI does not unwrap, reshape, or filter the response object before passing it to `CLIPrintResult`

execution_paths.title: Happy path: afc secrets create single scope (user default)

steps.action: runs `afc secrets create API_KEY=abc123` with no flags
parses `API_KEY=abc123` into key=`API_KEY`, value=`abc123`; detects all ownership flags at zero values; resolves to `user scope`
calls `CLIClientFromCmd` to obtain an authenticated `CLIClient`
sends POST to `/api/v1/user/secrets` with body `{"entries":[{"key":"API_KEY","value":"abc123"}]}`
stores the secret and returns `{"entries":[{"key":"API_KEY","created_at":"...","updated_at":"..."}]}`
calls `CLIPrintResult` with the full response object
serializes the response as JSON and writes it to stdout; command exits 0

execution_paths.title: Multi-scope create with partial failure: afc secrets create --user --org myorg

steps.action: runs `afc secrets create TOKEN=xyz --user --org myorg`
parses `TOKEN=xyz`; detects `--user` is true and `--org` is `myorg`; plans two API calls in order: user scope, then org scope
sends POST to `/api/v1/user/secrets` with the entries body; call succeeds
calls `CLIPrintResult` with the user-scope response; stdout receives the first JSON object
sends POST to `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets` with the entries body; call fails with an API error
calls `CLIHandleError` for the org-scope failure; sets `hadError` to `true`
all scopes processed; `hadError` is `true`; returns `NewCLIError(1, "")` from `RunE`
reads exit code 1 from the `CLIError` and terminates the process with exit code 1

execution_paths.title: Happy path: afc secrets delete (user scope)

steps.action: runs `afc secrets delete MY_SECRET` with no flags
reads positional argument `MY_SECRET`; detects all ownership flags at zero values; resolves to `user scope`
sends DELETE to `/api/v1/user/secrets/MY_SECRET`
deletes the secret and returns 204 No Content; `DoRequest` returns nil body
detects nil body; skips `CLIPrintResult`; calls `fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Secret 'MY_SECRET' has been deleted.\n")`
returns nil from `RunE`; command exits 0 with stdout silent and confirmation on stderr

execution_paths.title: Happy path: afc vars resolve (end-to-end through CLI and hub API)

steps.action: runs `afc vars resolve myworkspace`
reads positional argument `myworkspace`; validates no ownership flags are present
calls `CLIClientFromCmd` to obtain an authenticated `CLIClient`
sends GET to `/api/v1/workspaces/myworkspace/vars/resolved`
merges user, org, and workspace variable tiers with precedence and returns a JSON array of `{key, value, origin, created_at, updated_at}` objects
calls `CLIPrintResult` with the full response array
serializes the merged variable set as JSON and writes it to stdout; command exits 0

execution_paths.title: Argument validation failure: missing = in key=value argument

steps.action: runs `afc secrets create BADKEY` (no `=` character)
attempts to parse `BADKEY` as a `key=value` pair; finds no `=` character
returns `NewCLIError(2, message)` from `RunE` without calling `CLIClientFromCmd` or `DoRequest`
reads exit code 2 from the `CLIError`; writes the error message to stderr and terminates with exit code 2

error_handling.behavior: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; Cobra prints the error message to stderr and exits with code 2

error_handling.condition: Comma-splitting a create argument produces an empty or whitespace-only key at position N
error_handling.behavior: return `NewCLIError(2, "empty key in argument at position N")` from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; exits 2

error_handling.condition: Multiple ownership flags are provided to a list, update, or delete command
error_handling.behavior: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; exits 2 with an error message indicating only one scope selector is allowed

error_handling.condition: `DoRequest` returns an error for a single-scope command
error_handling.behavior: call `CLIHandleError(cmd, err)` and return the resulting error from `RunE`; the API error envelope is printed to stderr; exits non-zero

error_handling.condition: One or more scope calls fail during a multi-scope create
error_handling.behavior: call `CLIHandleError` immediately for each failing scope as it occurs; set `hadError` to `true`; continue remaining scopes; after all scopes complete, return `NewCLIError(1, "")` if `hadError` is `true`; exits 1

error_handling.condition: `CLIClientFromCmd` returns an error (e.g. missing or invalid API key)
error_handling.behavior: return the error from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; exits non-zero with the client initialization error on stderr

error_handling.condition: A required positional argument is missing (e.g. no key provided to delete, no slug to resolve)
error_handling.behavior: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; exits 2 with a usage error message on stderr

error_handling.condition: The API returns 404 for an update or delete on a key that does not exist
error_handling.behavior: call `CLIHandleError(cmd, err)` and return the resulting error from `RunE`; the JSON API error envelope is printed to stderr; exits non-zero; no confirmation message is printed for delete

error_handling.condition: `afc vars resolve` receives an ownership flag alongside the workspace slug argument
error_handling.behavior: return `NewCLIError(2, message)` from `RunE` without calling `DoRequest`; exits 2 with an error message indicating ownership flags are not accepted by this command

symbols.name: RootCommand
symbols.notes: Returns the root Cobra command for the CLI.

symbols.name: CLIClientFromCmd
symbols.notes: Instantiates an authenticated CLIClient from the Cobra command context using the configured API key or PAT.

symbols.name: CLIPrintResult
symbols.notes: Serializes v as JSON and writes it to stdout. Called with the full DoRequest response as-is. Not called for DELETE commands (nil body).

symbols.name: CLIHandleError
symbols.notes: Prints the API error envelope to stderr and returns the error for propagation.

symbols.name: NewCLIError
symbols.notes: Constructs a CLIError with a specific exit code. Used for exit code 2 (argument errors) and exit code 1 (partial multi-scope failure sentinel).

symbols.name: CLIClient.DoRequest
symbols.signature: func (c *CLIClient) DoRequest(ctx context.Context, method, path string, body any) (any, error)
symbols.notes: Executes an HTTP request against the hub REST API. Returns nil body for 204 No Content responses.
